title: Tech Note: Optimizing Searches with Hashes
author: David Adams
featured_technology: Nine hashing algorithms (AP, BKDR, DJB, ELF, JS, PJW, RS, SDBM, SumBytes)
Hash-optimized queries (alternative to QUERY BY FORMULA)
Case-sensitive / full-text / BLOB / picture / document searching

historical_commentary.text: This note tackles a genuine engine limitation of the era: 4D's classic database engine could not natively perform case-sensitive text searches, full BLOB/picture comparisons, or efficient full-text scans, so it teaches storing precomputed hashes and using indexed hash lookups plus QUERY BY FORMULA as a workaround, with detailed benchmark comparisons of nine hashing algorithms. The general technique (storing a hash for fast pre-filtering before an exact comparison) remains a valid, timeless database optimization pattern, but 4D's engine has since gained a proper SQL engine (v11 SQL, 2007) with richer native query/index capabilities, reducing how often developers need to hand-roll hash-based search optimizations for ordinary text search.
related_updates: 4D's SQL engine (introduced in v11 SQL) and subsequent query/indexing improvements provide more native options for advanced searches than were available in 2004/2005
The underlying hash-based pre-filtering technique described remains a generally applicable optimization pattern in any database system
